paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and round of conversation for two different feedback types. The x-axis is labeled “Round of Conversation” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5 with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 10 to 25 with tick labels at 5-unit intervals. A yellow line, marked with circular data points, represents “Binary” feedback, starting at a value of approximately 10% at Round 1 and increasing to approximately 22% at Round 5. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “Detailed” feedback, beginning at a value of approximately 13% at Round 1 and increasing to approximately 25% at Round 5.
